metadata.title: ShortTerm · Short stays. Long stories.
metadata.description: ShortTerm connects people who have a room available for a fixed period with people looking for one. Post or search, chat directly, and coordinate your stay.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: ShortTerm connects people — it doesn't manage bookings or payments. You coordinate everything directly with the other person.

steps.title: Post or search for a room
steps.description: Hosts post their available room for fixed dates. People searching filter by city and dates.

steps.title: Reach out by chat
steps.description: Message directly within the app to ask questions and get to know the other person before deciding.

steps.title: Work out the details
steps.description: Price, house rules, move-in and move-out dates: it's all discussed and agreed between the two of you.

steps.title: Confirm the match
steps.description: Once both sides agree, you confirm the match inside the app and you're set.

reasons.title: Real people
reasons.description: Profiles with a name, habits, and preferences, so you know who you'll be living with before deciding.

reasons.title: No booking fees
reasons.description: ShortTerm doesn't charge to book or process payments. It just connects people; the rest is up to you.

reasons.title: Direct chat
reasons.description: No middlemen or endless forms: you talk directly with the other person from the very first message.

reasons.title: Built for short stays
reasons.description: Fixed dates, no long contracts: ideal for work trips, exchanges, or temporary moves.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNotice: This document is a draft and has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer — do not publish it as a final version.

sections.heading: 1. What data we collect
body: When you create a ShortTerm account, we collect your email address and, if you choose to sign in with Google, the basic Google profile information needed for authentication.

We also collect your profile information: name, nationality, languages you speak, profile photo, and lifestyle preferences (habits, schedule, whether you smoke, whether you have pets). This information is used solely to show compatibility between hosts and seekers.
If you post a room as a host, we collect the data for that listing: address, location, photos, price, and house rules.
We collect the messages you send through chat with other users inside the app, once you've matched.
We collect a push notification token from your device so we can send you notifications about your activity in the app.

sections.heading: 2. Who we share data with
body: We don't sell your data. We share information with the following providers, who process data on our behalf so the app can work:
list: Supabase — database, authentication, and file storage (hosting infrastructure).
Google — only if you choose to sign in with Google (OAuth).
Sentry — error and crash monitoring, including session replay, which may include personal data.
Brevo — sending transactional emails, for example notifications about reports.

sections.heading: 3. What we use your data for
body: We use your data to connect hosts with seekers, enable chat within the app, send you transactional notifications, process safety reports, and fix application bugs.

sections.heading: 4. What we do NOT use your data for
body: ShortTerm doesn't process payments: the app has no payment or booking feature, so we don't collect or process card or payment data.
We don't use your data for ad targeting.
We don't sell your data to third parties.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights
body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by writing to the contact address listed at the end of this document.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention and deletion
body: When you delete your account from the app, your profile is removed following the app's deletion flow. Exact retention periods for each type of data are subject to legal and product review, and will be detailed in the final version of this document.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
body: For questions about this policy or your personal data, write to us at privacidad@shortterm-app.com.
